title: CO-335 promote Codex CLI 0.123 cloud gates
body:
## What
- Promote CO's Codex CLI posture and release-planning candidate to 0.123.0 after fresh CO-335 cloud evidence.
- Align release-facing workflow pins, public guidance, shipped skill guidance, and pack-smoke assertions to @openai/codex@0.123.0.
- Add the CO-335 docs-first packet and task mirrors with exact required/fallback cloud-gate evidence.

## Why
CO-322 held 0.123.0 because the required cloud canary failed before submission against stale environment 6999395fcc448191b865917084f21c6f. CO-335 reran the current required and fallback cloud gates after auth/env rotation and both passed.

## Evidence
- Required cloud manifest: .runs/linear-919ecdfa-9be9-4d93-995b-7f8e4a784e6f-cloud-required-0123-current/cli/2026-04-23T10-07-13-661Z-02403ae9/manifest.json
- Required cloud task: task_e_69e9ef5628408327b88b1fcd0ab14b24, environment Kbediako/CO, status ready, poll_count 24
- Fallback manifest: .runs/linear-919ecdfa-9be9-4d93-995b-7f8e4a784e6f-cloud-fallback-0123-current/cli/2026-04-23T10-11-43-645Z-48d460ec/manifest.json
- Fallback contract: mode_requested=cloud, mode_used=mcp, issue=missing_environment

## Validation
- node scripts/delegation-guard.mjs
- node scripts/spec-guard.mjs --dry-run
- npm run build
- npm run lint
- npm run test
- npm run docs:check
- npm run docs:freshness
- npm run repo:stewardship
- node scripts/diff-budget.mjs
- npm run pack:smoke
- npm run review -- --manifest .runs/linear-919ecdfa-9be9-4d93-995b-7f8e4a784e6f-cloud-required-0123-current/cli/2026-04-23T10-07-13-661Z-02403ae9/manifest.json --base origin/main --title 'CO-335 promote Codex CLI 0.123 cloud gates' (bounded-success)

Linear: CO-335
